description: This Python source file defines classes and functions related to managing a realtime context for OpenAI language models, including session handling, message processing, and integration with a realtime API. It extends existing classes to support real-time message conversions and processing frames for a conversational AI system.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext
classes.description: Extends OpenAILLMContext to support real-time session management, message conversion, and session instructions handling. It includes methods for upgrading contexts, converting standard messages for realtime use, and summarizing current conversation history.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeUserContextAggregator
classes.description: Handles processing of user input frames in a realtime conversational context, including updating message history and ignoring certain input types for real-time processing.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: Processes assistant output frames in a realtime setting, filtering out duplicate text frames and handling function call results for real-time API communication.
